intro: Saturday brings a water-use request in Squamish, fresh tools for generative media and a deadline for GitHub report users. A dance performance, an Indigenous technology conference and Gastown reservations offer ways to plan ahead.

stories.title: Squamish asks residents to cut indoor water use
stories.summary: Squamish is asking residents to limit indoor water use until further notice to help manage sewer flows after heavy weather. More rain is expected, and peak periods could add pressure to the system.

stories.title: A Trainium experiment speeds up video generation
stories.summary: A Hugging Face experiment ran LTX-2.5 video generation across 32 AWS Trainium3 NeuronCores, reporting 22 to 23 seconds for a 10-second clip after model loading. The walkthrough shares code and the parallel-processing changes behind the result.

stories.title: Kandinsky Lab releases image, video and audio tokenizers
stories.summary: Kandinsky Lab introduced KVAE-3.0, a set of models that compress images, video and stereo audio into representations for generative systems. The team published model weights and inference code alongside its reconstruction and generation comparisons.

stories.title: A training recipe targets compact language encoders
stories.summary: Researchers introduced ModernELECTRA and two compact EdgeCoder models, including a multilingual version covering 46 languages. Their walkthrough explains a training method intended to support both classification and embeddings, with examples for developers to try.

stories.title: GitHub usage exports gain a user ID column
stories.summary: Beginning December 1, several GitHub usage reports will add a user ID beside the username, shifting subsequent columns. GitHub advises teams that parse reports by column position to switch to header names before the change.

events.date: 2027-01-22 · 8 p.m. · Vancouver Playhouse, 600 Hamilton Street, Vancouver
events.title: Rhino brings a shifting dreamscape to PuSh
events.description: Vancouver-based Out Innerspace presents a dance work in which human and animal figures emerge from darkness. A post-show talkback follows the January 22 performance; the work also plays January 23 and contains haze and flashing lights.

meetups.date: 2027-01-26 · Sheraton Vancouver Airport Hotel, 7551 Westminster Highway, Richmond
meetups.title: Indigenous Tech Conference plans three days of exchange
meetups.description: Tech Circle’s January 26–28 conference brings Indigenous innovators, founders and community leaders together for an expo, panels and workshops. The program includes hands-on AI and cybersecurity labs, as well as sessions on language and technology.

dining.date: December 2026 · The Moon, 59 Powell Street, Vancouver
dining.title: December reservations open at The Moon
dining.description: The Gastown restaurant has opened December reservations for its dining room and martini bar. The dining room serves seasonal plates Thursday through Sunday; the separate bar offers snacks and desserts, with the same drinks list in both rooms.
